India Condemns Pakistan Air Strikes in Afghanistan

India has strongly condemned Pakistan's recent air strikes on Afghan territory, labeling them a "blatant act of aggression" and a "direct threat to regional peace." The Ministry of External Affairs reiterated support for Afghanistan's sovereignty and territorial integrity. The strikes reportedly resulted in civilian casualties, with one report mentioning 28 deaths and another 36.
